doc.title: ZNY – PCT LOA
doc.summary: LOA between New York ARTCC and Potomac TRACON: IAD/DCA/BWI arrival handoff altitudes and crossings, BWI/DCA departure rules, T291/T295 overflights, holding at SKILS/TRISH/BINNS/RIKTR, airspace delegation sections and satellite airport lists.

items.title: Purpose and scope
items.text: Prescribes transfer of control and radar handoff procedures, route/altitude assignments and airspace delegation between New York ARTCC (ZNY) and Potomac TRACON (PCT). Procedures apply unless prior coordination is effected.

items.title: ZNY delegates approach control area to PCT
items.text: ZNY delegates to PCT authority and responsibility for control of arrival, departure and tower enroute aircraft within the approach control area depicted on Attachment 1.

items.title: 10nm separation at transfer of control
items.text: Minimum radar separation between aircraft when transfer of control is accomplished shall be at least 10 nautical miles, constant or increasing.

items.title: TCP is the delegated airspace boundary
items.text: The Center/TRACON delegated airspace shall be the transfer of control point (TCP).

items.title: Verbal coordination for V39 / V143 overflights
items.text: Verbal coordination is required for overflight traffic on (routed via) V39 and V143.

items.title: Each facility does its own internal coordination
items.text: Regardless of which facility requests holding and/or altitude/route changes affecting additional sectors in the adjacent facility's area, each facility is responsible for all its own necessary internal coordination.

items.title: IAD jets from LRP: descending to 15,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite jet arrivals from LRP (except those originating in the PHL Terminal Area) will be handed off to PCT descending to 15,000'. PCT has control for turns up to 45 deg right of course at the TCP and must point these aircraft out to ZNY if necessary.

items.title: IAD jets from PHL/WRI/RDG: climbing to 14,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite jet arrivals originating in the PHL, WRI and RDG Terminal Areas will be handed off to PCT climbing to 14,000', not in trail with other LRP jet arrivals. (RDG area not defined; KRDG only.)

items.title: IAD jets from PSB/HAR: AOB 14,000 desc 13,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite jet arrivals from PSB/HAR (except those originating in the MDT Terminal Area) will be handed off to PCT at or below 14,000' descending to 13,000'. PCT has control for turns up to 30 deg left or right of course south of the centerline of V474.

items.title: IAD jets from MDT area: at 11,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite jet arrivals originating from the MDT Terminal Area will be handed off to PCT at 11,000', not in trail with other PSB/HAR jet arrivals. PCT has control for turns up to 30 deg left or right of course south of the centerline of V474.

items.title: IAD props from LRP/DELRO: descending to 12,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite prop arrivals from LRP/DELRO will be handed off to PCT descending to 12,000'.

items.title: IAD props from TROYZ STAR: 12,000 and 250kts
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite prop arrivals from TROYZ STAR will be handed off to PCT descending to 12,000' and 250 knots.

items.title: IAD props from PSB/HAR: descending to 9,000
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite prop arrivals from PSB/HAR will be handed off to PCT descending to 9,000'. PCT has control for turns up to 30 deg left or right of course south of the centerline of V474. Note: with a simultaneous BWI or DCA prop arrival, the IAD prop will be descending to 10,000'.

items.title: IAD props from MDT area: TEC
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite prop arrivals from the MDT Terminal Areas must be handled tower en route control (TEC). TEC routes are low-altitude IFR routes requiring no ATC above approach control; they can be found in the Preferred Routes Database.

items.title: PCT may change IAD arrival beacon codes S of V474
items.text: PCT must have control to change beacon code assignments to IAD arrival aircraft south of the centerline of V474.

items.title: IAD props ≤210kias from PHL/WRI: TEC
items.text: IAD & IAD satellite prop arrivals not capable of speeds greater than 210kias from the PHL and WRI Terminal Areas must be handled TEC.

items.title: DCA jets: in-trail MXE with LRP/PSB
items.text: ZNY must provide in-trail spacing between DCA & DCA satellite jet arrivals from MXE and LRP/PSB.

items.title: DCA jets from MXE: CLIPR/20NE BAL at 12,000
items.text: DCA & DCA satellite jet arrivals from MXE will be handed off to PCT to cross CLIPR or cross 20nm northeast of BAL at 12,000'.

items.title: DCA jets from LRP/PSB: SKILS/20N BAL at 12,000
items.text: DCA & DCA satellite jet arrivals from LRP/PSB will be handed off to PCT to cross SKILS or cross 20nm north of BAL at 12,000'.

items.title: DCA props from MXE: TROYZ/40NE BAL at 11,000
items.text: DCA & DCA satellite props from MXE will be handed off to PCT to cross TROYZ or cross 40nm northeast of BAL at 11,000'.

items.title: DCA props from LRP: at 10,000
items.text: DCA & DCA satellite props from LRP will be handed off to PCT at 10,000'.

items.title: DCA props from HAR/PSB: descending to 9,000
items.text: DCA & DCA satellite props from HAR/PSB will be handed off to PCT descending to 9,000'.

items.title: PCT may change DCA arrival beacon codes in 30nm BAL
items.text: PCT must have control to change beacon code assignments to DCA arrival aircraft within 30nm of BAL.

items.title: BWI jets: in-trail MXE with LRP
items.text: ZNY must provide in-trail spacing between BWI & BWI satellite jet arrivals from MXE and LRP.

items.title: BWI jets from MXE: 25SW MXE/40N BAL 12,000 250
items.text: BWI & BWI satellite jet arrivals from MXE will be handed off to PCT to cross 25nm southwest of MXE or cross 40nm north of BAL at 12,000' and 250kias.

items.title: BWI jets from LRP: 25S LRP/40N BAL 12,000 250
items.text: BWI & BWI satellite jet arrivals from LRP will be handed off to PCT to cross 25nm south of LRP or cross 40nm north of BAL at 12,000' and 250kias.

items.title: BWI props from MXE: TROYZ/40N BAL at 11,000
items.text: BWI & BWI satellite props from MXE will be handed off to PCT to cross TROYZ or cross 40nm north of BAL at 11,000'.

items.title: BWI props from LRP: at 9,000
items.text: BWI & BWI satellite props from LRP will be handed off to PCT at 9,000'.

items.title: BWI props from HAR/PSB: descending to 9,000
items.text: BWI & BWI satellite props from HAR/PSB will be handed off to PCT descending to 9,000'.

items.title: PCT may change BWI arrival beacon codes in 40nm BAL
items.text: PCT must have control to change beacon code assignments to BWI arrival aircraft within 40nm of BAL.

items.title: PCT may vector BWI arrivals to BAL south of V408
items.text: PCT may vector BWI arrivals toward BAL south of the centerline of V408. PCT is responsible for separating SKILS arrivals from those over TRISH.

items.title: ZNY advises PCT of approval-only departures
items.text: ZNY must advise PCT when departure clearances for BWI, BWI satellite, DCA and DCA satellite departures will be on approval basis only.

items.title: BWI/DCA+ requesting 17,000 or below: Att 3 routes
items.text: BWI, BWI satellite, DCA and DCA satellite departures requesting 17,000' or below must be cleared via the routes described in Attachment 3.

items.title: BWI/DCA+ departures: 11,000 or lower requested
items.text: BWI, BWI satellite, DCA and DCA satellite departures must be cleared to 11,000' or lower requested altitude.

items.title: ZNY climb/turns 30 deg N of MXE 267 radial
items.text: For BWI, BWI satellite, DCA and DCA satellite departures, ZNY has control for climb and/or turns 30 deg either side of course north of the centerline of the MXE267 radial.
items.restr: ZNY climb/turns N of MXE R-267

items.title: PCT may clear LRP-routed departures direct LRP
items.text: PCT may clear BWI, BWI satellite, DCA and DCA satellite departures routed via LRP direct LRP without coordination.

items.title: RNAV overflights T291/T295: AOB 11,000
items.text: RNAV overflight traffic routed via T291 and T295 must be at or below 11,000'.

items.title: T291/T295: ZNY may clear direct BAABS
items.text: ZNY may clear RNAV overflight traffic routed via T291 and T295 direct BAABS without coordination.

items.title: T291/T295: PCT may clear direct LRP or HAR
items.text: PCT may clear RNAV overflight traffic routed via T291 and T295 direct LRP or HAR without coordination.

items.title: BELAY coordinates NB T291 9,000–11,000 with BINNS
items.text: PCT BELAY Sector must coordinate northbound traffic routed via T291 at 9,000' through 11,000' with PCT BINNS Sector prior to transfer of control to ZNY.

items.title: Advise other facility when holding
items.text: When holding is necessary each facility will advise the other as soon as possible.

items.title: SKILS/TRISH holding: ZNY coordinates details
items.text: For holding at SKILS or TRISH, ZNY must coordinate the call sign, altitude and time over the fix for aircraft in hold.

items.title: SKILS/TRISH holding: PCT takes 14,000 and below
items.text: For holding at SKILS or TRISH, PCT must accept transfer of communications and control of aircraft at 14,000' and below in delegated airspace in the holding pattern areas and arrival routes on Attachment 4, from the highest altitude released by ZNY.

items.title: Holding: PCT releases altitudes back to ZNY
items.text: For holding at SKILS, TRISH or BINNS, PCT must release altitudes back to ZNY by stating the aircraft call sign and altitude vacated.

items.title: Hold at BINNS above 15,000 when HYPER full
items.text: When all available holding altitudes at HYPER are occupied, ZNY will hold at BINNS above 15,000'.

items.title: BINNS holding: handoff at 15,000
items.text: ZNY will hand off BINNS holding aircraft at 15,000'. Upon PCT acceptance, ZNY transfers communications and control for turns within the BINNS holding pattern airspace and arrival route (Attachment 4) at 15,000' to PCT.

items.title: Hold at RIKTR above 12,000
items.text: ZNY shall hold aircraft at RIKTR above 12,000'.
